d: France has been rocked by weeks of protests. Students are angry about overcrowded classrooms, missing teachers and an admissions system they say is unfair. Workers are furious about the cost of living and planned spending cuts. Now, the government is offering more university seats, additional teachers and billions of euros in loans for schools. But protesters say the concessions do not go far enough. With more demonstrations planned, can Macron restore order and public trust? Or is France heading for another showdown? Palki Sharma tells you.
